# eslee-tray-folder v0.1.3

- Command/menu replies are bound to their registered app. Another client's response cannot consume a pending request.
- Invalid/null/duplicate app configuration entries recover with an original-file backup. Failed settings saves preserve live paths and modes.
- README now describes the five-app catalog and hosted/standalone fallback/reconnect behavior.
- Fifty safe tests passed during audit verification. A separate-process Windows smoke passed two host lifecycles with isolated pipe/mutex/event names and temporary config; it now runs in PR and release CI.
- Native tray icon visuals, user-window restoration and installer upgrade/uninstall UX were not visually exercised. No existing user app was stopped or launched during verification.

Release assets include SHA-256 checksums and a manifest recording the exact source commit and successful release checks. A tag/source-version mismatch, missing asset or failed check stops publication. Existing releases are never overwritten.
